name: @vectis/docs
//scripts: The docs consume `dist`, exactly as an npm consumer does, so the library must be BUILT first. `pnpm -r build` orders the workspace topologically and already does it; `dev`, `preview` and `typecheck` are not run under -r, hence their own prerequisite. `postinstall` is not optional: it writes .nuxt/tsconfig.json, without which ESLint's type-aware block fails with "file not found in project" on every .ts here.
